item.title: Trump's war on Iran comes home to haunt Republicans
item.description: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections resulted in a sweeping Democratic victory, with voters rejecting Republicans largely because of the war against Iran which drove up gasoline prices amid broader inflation.

item.title: Persian translation of al-Baladhuri’s landmark historical work unveiled at University of Tehran
item.description: The 13-volume translation brings a major source on early Islamic history, Arab-Iranian cultural ties and Iran's historical heritage to Persian-speaking readers.

item.title: Iran thrash Saudi Arabia to book semi-final berth at AFC Beach Soccer Asian Cup 2026
item.description: Iran maintain their title defence in dominant fashion, extending their winning run to four matches as they close in on a fifth continental crown.

item.title: Iran's military might, readiness at new high, enemy already feels defeat: IRGC chief
item.description: The IRGC commander says Iran's enemies are facing one of their most critical periods despite their extensive efforts to undermine the nation's resolve.

item.title: Trump says war on Iran funded only through January, claims ‘regime change’ not his goal
item.description: Trump says the US war against Iran is funded only through January, claiming that ‘regime change’ was never his goal.

item.title: Two oil tankers catch fire after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: The IRGC Navy warns vessels against covert passage and sailing with their navigation systems switched off in the Strait of Hormuz, saying they could face the danger of naval mine explosions.

item.title: Iran warns against weaponization of AI, demands accountability and reparations for US aggression
item.description: Darzi says technology must serve humanity and be used exclusively for peaceful purposes, not aggression, domination or violations of state sovereignty.

item.title: IRGC Navy renews warning as cargo vessel strikes mine south of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The IRGC Navy says the vessel, backed by US military aircraft, had attempted to secretly transit the strait through an unauthorized route.

item.title: Iran's air defenses deliver double blow, down US LUCAS, MQ-9 drones over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The Army has described the operations as part of its response to “hostile aerial activity.”

item.title: Araghchi: US crippling OPCW, threatening international security
item.description: Reuters recently reported that the world’s chemical weapons watchdog is facing a budget crisis, due in large part to missing payments from the United States.

item.title: Iran security chief: Trump’s blockade plans as ‘delusional and futile’ as failed war
item.description: Rezaee dismisses Washington’s latest pressure campaign as another doomed attempt to isolate Iran, stressing Tehran’s resolve to overcome the blockade and counter any fresh aggression.

item.title: Iran to strike distant enemy warships in any new war: IRGC deputy commander
item.description: Major General Mostafa Izadi warned that Tehran will expand the confrontation beyond the region if enemy movements against Iran continue.

item.title: Unions, immigrant advocates demand airlines do more to hinder ICE arrests at US airports
item.description: A couple of hundred people rallied outside Alaska Airlines headquarters on Tuesday, demanding the company do more in hindering US Immigration and Customs Enforcement activities at airports.

item.title: Hundreds of Venezuelan workers march to demand better wages, year-end bonus
item.description: Hundreds of workers march through the streets of Caracas toward the Miraflores Palace to demand fair wages and decent pensions from Delcy Rodriguez's government.

item.title: Bangladesh garment workers protest as unrest over wages escalates
item.description: Bangladesh garment workers blocked roads and caused heavy traffic congestions as they faced off with law enforcement personnel during a protest demanding pay hikes.
